title: The Episode of Malerkotla's Pathan Khawaja Khijar And the Death of his two Brothers

blocks.text: The battle develops into a trench battle in which the Majhail Singhs and the Malerkotla Pathans exchange fire while the Sikhs alternate between lying low and surging forward under pressure.
Hunger, thirst, and artillery do not break the Khalsa line, and when Khawaja Khijar presses the assault he is struck down, with his brothers also drawn toward death trying to recover him.
The trench battle thus becomes the setting in which Khawaja Khijar’s house is shattered and the Pathan advance loses its edge.
